author: sorianosantiagosam
name: silk-shader
description: Static WebGL shader background in the Silk style. Generated by the 21st.dev Shader Builder. 4-color palette (#1A1423, #B75D69, #EACDC2, #FFF5EB). Features: cursor-reactive (repel). A drop-in, zero-dependency React component for hero sections and animated gradient/noise backgrounds.
